name: CardSettlement
description: Record of the cleared and settled card transaction, created by SVC-011 in PH-045 (JRN-011) when the end-of-day clearing file from the card scheme is processed. Links to the pre-authorised CardAuthorisation (ENT-032) via auth_id FK. The settlement_amount may differ from the original authorisation amount (gratuity, currency conversion variance). Stores the financial economics: interchange_fee (issuer income from acquirer), scheme_fee (cost to bank), and net_amount. Required for PSR interchange cap compliance monitoring (GOV-003-R05) and FCA BCOBS 7-year account record retention.

fields.name: auth_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → CardAuthorisation.auth_id (ENT-032). Must reference an approved CardAuthorisation. Immutable.

fields.name: card_number_token
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same card_number_token as associated ENT-032. Denormalised for query efficiency within PCI CDE. Never raw PAN.
fields.pci_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1. Denormalised within PCI CDE for settlement reconciliation query performance. card_number_token is the ONLY card identifier.

fields.name: settlement_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 date. Typically T+1 from authorisation date.

fields.name: settlement_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Final settled amount in GBP. May differ from ENT-032.billing_amount_gbp. Must be > 0.

fields.name: interchange_fee
fields.validation_rule: Required. Interchange fee paid to bank (as issuer) by the acquiring bank. Non-negative. Subject to PSR interchange cap: debit ≤ 0.2% of transaction value; credit ≤ 0.3%.

fields.name: scheme_fee
fields.validation_rule: Required. Fee charged by Visa or Mastercard. Non-negative.

fields.name: settled_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of settlement record creation. Immutable.

relationships.description: CardSettlement is the settlement record for one CardAuthorisation. FK: auth_id.

design_decisions.decision: interchange_fee and scheme_fee are stored as separate fields rather than only net_amount.
design_decisions.rationale: Interchange is revenue to the bank; scheme_fee is a cost. Storing separately enables accurate P&L attribution and PSR interchange cap compliance monitoring (GOV-003-R05).

design_decisions.decision: card_number_token is denormalised onto CardSettlement for query performance within the PCI CDE.
design_decisions.rationale: Settlement reconciliation queries require card-level aggregation. Denormalising avoids a join across ENT-032 for every settlement query. Strictly within SVC-011 PCI CDE — card_number_token never surfaces in event payloads as a result.
